sentences.text: Kuzhina ka një dritare të madhe.
sentences.english: The kitchen has a big window.

sentences.text: Sam pi ujë dhe ha bukë.
sentences.english: Sam drinks water and eats bread.

sentences.text: Tani Sam nuk është i lodhur.

sentences.english: He reads a little in Albanian.
Then Sam goes to the market.

sentences.text: Rruga e tregut nuk është e gjatë.
sentences.english: The road to the market is not long.

sentences.text: Në treg është gjyshi i Ardit.
sentences.english: Ardi's grandfather is at the market.
The grandfather gives him a loaf of bread.
